verdict.rationale: Browserbase has a dashboard (agent run view) and claims observability through rich logs, live view and session replay. It also lets you observe sessions programmatically and receive status-change webhooks. That covers per-session monitoring, but the evidence never shows a real-time dashboard of system metrics or pool status. Missing for 10: a documented real-time metrics dashboard, browser/worker pool or concurrency status views, system-level metrics (utilization, queue, errors), and independent corroboration.
